chapter.heading: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song.
chapter.v:
His foundation
is in the holy mountains.

Yahweh loves
the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

Glorious things
are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

I will
record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me.Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia:“This one was born there.”

Yes, of
Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;”the Most High himself will establish her.

Yahweh will
count, when he writes up the peoples,“This one was born there.” Selah.

Those who
sing as well as those who dance say,“All my springs are in you.”
